title: Canva MCP
lede: Canva has made its MCP server generally available, letting AI agents create editable designs, images and videos and call Canva tools such as background removal and resizing.

points: The MCP server is generally available, with no waitlist.
Agents produce designs, images and videos that stay editable in Canva rather than arriving as flat files.
Exposed tools include Magic Layers, background removal and creative resizing.
New REST APIs and an expanded CLI give developers the same capabilities, and Canva Craft image generation is reachable through both API and MCP.
The launch comment says close to 500,000 people signed up for Canva through MCP in the past month.

sections.text: Marketing teams and solo developers who turn out many on-brand graphics and want an agent to generate and resize them while keeping every file editable.
